editor.label: Cluster ID
editor.description: Servers with the same Cluster ID that belong to the same owner on the same machine form a cluster: players can transfer characters, items and creatures between them. Letters, numbers, - and _ only.

editor.label: Map
editor.description: The map to load. Every map is a separate world save.

editor.label: Mods (CurseForge IDs)
editor.description: Comma-separated CurseForge project IDs, for example 927090,928708. The server downloads these mods itself when it starts. The Mods page adds and removes IDs here for mods whose authors allow third-party downloads; for any other mod, add its ID here by hand (it is in the mod's CurseForge page URL / About box).

editor.label: tick is hardcore
editor.description: If True, enables Hardcore mode (player characters revert to level 1 upon death)

editor.label: tick is true (PvP)
editor.description: If True, disables PvP and enables PvE

editor.label: Tribe Name Change Cooldown
editor.description: Cool-down, in minutes, in between tribe name changes.

editor.label: Server Password
editor.description: Players need this password to join. Leave empty for a public server.

editor.label: Admin / RCON Password
editor.description: Used for admin commands in game (enablecheats) and by the panel console. Required for the console and for a clean stop.

editor.label: PvE
editor.description: Checked = PvE (players cannot damage each other). Unchecked = PvP.

editor.label: Hardcore
editor.description: Players restart at level 1 when they die.

editor.label: Auto Save (minutes)
editor.description: How often the world is saved.

editor.label: Kick Idle Players (seconds)
editor.description: Idle players are kicked after this many seconds.

editor.label: Start Time (hour)
editor.description: Time of day when the server starts, 0-23. -1 keeps the saved time.

editor.label: Crosshair
editor.description: Show the crosshair.

editor.label: Third Person View
editor.description: Allow the third person camera.

editor.label: Show Player on Map
editor.description: Show each player's own position on the map.

editor.label: Hit Markers
editor.description: Show hit markers on ranged attacks.

editor.label: Hide Damage Source in Tribe Logs
editor.description: Tribe logs do not name who destroyed a structure or killed a creature.

editor.label: Tribe Name Change Cooldown (minutes)
editor.description: Minutes between tribe renames.

editor.label: Oxygen Swim Speed Multiplier
editor.description: How much the oxygen stat adds to swimming speed.

editor.label: Item Stack Size Multiplier
editor.description: Multiplies the stack size of every item.

editor.label: Always Allow Structure Pickup
editor.description: Structures can be picked up at any time, not only right after placing them.

editor.label: Pickup Time After Placement (seconds)
editor.description: Seconds after placing a structure during which it can be picked up.

editor.label: Pickup Hold Duration (seconds)
editor.description: How long the pickup key must be held.

editor.label: Max Structures in Range
editor.description: Maximum number of structures in one area.

editor.label: Platform Max Structures Multiplier
editor.description: Multiplies how many structures a platform saddle or raft holds.

editor.label: Platform Build Area Multiplier
editor.description: Multiplies how far from a platform you can build.

editor.label: Structure Resource Radius Multiplier
editor.description: Multiplies the radius around structures where resources do not respawn.

editor.label: Max Tamed Creatures
editor.description: Maximum number of tamed creatures on the server.

editor.label: PvE Creature Decay Multiplier
editor.description: Multiplies how long tamed creatures last before they become unclaimed (PvE).

editor.label: Raid Creature Food Drain Multiplier
editor.description: Multiplies how fast raid creatures (such as the Titanosaur) get hungry.

configFiles.description: Game rules (Game.ini). Empty = official defaults; add settings under [/script/shootergame.shootergamemode].
